# Week Health

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The health-related summary for a week.

## Scope note

Broader than WeekDiabetes; covers non-diabetes-specific health data aggregated at the week level, alongside diabetes-specific tracking.

## Broader

- [Week Cluster](../WeekCluster/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
